entries.description: MCP server (Streamable-HTTP at https://s.illo.fyi/mcp) for bundling groups of links into short shareable stash URLs, resolving them, and decoding payload strings.
representativeQueries: share these five links as one stash URL
resolve the short stash link AHK7QY
decode this stash payload into a list of URLs

entries.description: Stateless HTTP decode of stash payloads from share URLs with JSON, Markdown and plain-text content negotiation.
representativeQueries: read the links from a stash share URL
convert a stash payload to markdown
list URLs contained in a stash payload
